strings.cfg_schedule__enabled_help: Off: no new weather events start and a running one ends at once. The weather filter still applies.
strings.cfg_schedule__blizzard_chance_per_day_he: Chance that a blizzard starts on a given in-game day (rolled once a day at a random time).
strings.cfg_schedule__thunderstorm_chance_per_da: Chance that a Severe Thunderstorm starts on a given in-game day.
strings.cfg_schedule__lightning_storm_chance_hel: Chance that a new thunderstorm is a Lightning Storm: the same wind, thunder and darkness with more lightning (Lightning Storm Strike Multiplier) and no rain, so with Strike Starts Fires on its strikes can set things alight. Rolled once when each storm starts; changes apply to the next storm. Host setting (server value applies to everyone). Default 0.05 (5%).
strings.cfg_schedule__minimum_days_between_event: In-game days that must pass after an event started before the next one may start.
strings.cfg_schedule__warning_seconds_help: Length of the warning phase: pale haze first, then light snow or rain in the last minute.
strings.cfg_schedule__active_min_seconds_help: Shortest length of the event itself.
strings.cfg_schedule__active_max_seconds_help: Longest length of the event itself; a value below Active Min Seconds counts as Active Min Seconds.
strings.cfg_schedule__blizzard_biomes_help: Biomes a blizzard covers, separated by commas: Meadows, BlackForest, Swamp, Plains, DeepNorth. In the Deep North a blizzard is a whiteout: the twilight snowstorm with thicker fog and full wind. Default: Meadows, BlackForest, DeepNorth. Tempest events never occur in the Mountain or Mistlands, and only a blizzard reaches the Deep North; names a kind does not cover are dropped.
strings.cfg_schedule__thunderstorm_biomes_help: Biomes a Severe Thunderstorm covers, separated by commas: Meadows, BlackForest, Swamp, Plains, Ocean. Tempest events never occur in the Mountain or Mistlands, and only a blizzard reaches the Deep North; names a kind does not cover are dropped.
strings.cfg_schedule__dense_fog_chance_help: Chance that Dense Fog starts on a given in-game day: thick fog that cuts sight to about 15 to 20 meters. No damage. Each kind owns its own share of the daily roll, so this does not change the other kinds' chances (while all chances add up to at most 1). Host setting (server value applies to everyone); applies from the next daily roll. Default 0.04 (4%).
strings.cfg_schedule__dense_fog_biomes_help: Biomes Dense Fog covers, separated by commas: Meadows, BlackForest, Swamp, Plains, Ocean. Empty: Dense Fog never starts. Host setting (server value applies to everyone). Default: all five. Tempest events never occur in the Mountain or Mistlands, and only a blizzard reaches the Deep North; names a kind does not cover are dropped.
strings.cfg_schedule__ash_storm_chance_help: Chance that an Ash Storm starts on a given in-game day in the Ashlands: a heavy ash storm that burns players out in the open every 5 seconds (Storm Hazards Affect Players and Storm Hazard Damage). A roof or an interior protects. Host setting (server value applies to everyone); applies from the next daily roll. Default 0.05 (5%).
strings.cfg_schedule__ash_storm_biomes_help: Biomes an Ash Storm covers: AshLands, or empty so it never starts. Host setting (server value applies to everyone). Default: AshLands. Tempest events never occur in the Mountain or Mistlands, and only a blizzard reaches the Deep North; names a kind does not cover are dropped.
strings.cfg_schedule__meteor_shower_chance_help: Chance that a Meteor Shower is rolled on a given in-game day. It always falls at night: rolled by day, its warning lasts until nightfall, and it ends at dawn. Meteors land like strikes (Strikes Per Minute, Strike Damage, Strike Hurts Players, Strike Hits Trees, Base Clearance), and with Strike Starts Fires on and no rain they set things alight. Host setting (server value applies to everyone); applies from the next daily roll. Default 0.03 (3%).
strings.cfg_schedule__meteor_shower_biomes_help: Biomes a Meteor Shower covers, separated by commas: Plains, AshLands. Empty: it never starts. Host setting (server value applies to everyone). Default: Plains, AshLands. Tempest events never occur in the Mountain or Mistlands, and only a blizzard reaches the Deep North; names a kind does not cover are dropped.
strings.cfg_effects__blizzard_freezing_help: Freezing: as in the Mountains (shelter and fire protect). Cold: cold only. None: no cold effect from the blizzard.
strings.cfg_effects__strikes_per_minute_help: Ground lightning strikes per minute around each player in a Severe Thunderstorm, and meteor impacts per minute in a Meteor Shower. 0: no strikes.
strings.cfg_effects__lightning_storm_strike_mult: Strikes Per Minute is multiplied by this during a Lightning Storm (rounded, at most 30 a minute). Applies at once. Host setting (server value applies to everyone). Default 2.
strings.cfg_effects__strike_damage_help: Damage of one strike: lightning for a lightning strike, blunt for a meteor impact (half of it fire while Strike Starts Fires applies).
strings.cfg_effects__strike_hurts_players_help: Off: strikes hit only terrain, trees and creatures.
strings.cfg_effects__strike_starts_fires_help: On: when it is not raining, each strike deals half of Strike Damage as fire and sets one burnable thing at the impact alight with the game's own fire: a tree (when Strike Hits Trees is on) or dry grass. While Storm Hazards Affect Players is on, a player standing in a strike's ground lightning also gets the game's Burning effect and Storm Hazard Damage is split evenly between lightning and fire. Rain cancels all of this: strikes then deal only lightning damage and the ground lightning only shocks. Thunderstorms are usually rainy, so fires are rare. Fire spreads only where the game allows it (Ashlands or the Fire world modifier). No fire starts inside a ward, a shield or Base Clearance, and player-built pieces are never set alight. Meteor Shower impacts follow the same rules. Host setting: applies to every player in the world and takes effect at once. Default: off.
strings.cfg_effects__base_clearance_help: Meters around player-built pieces where no strike lands, in addition to base and ward areas.
strings.cfg_effects__storm_hazards_affect_player: On: a player standing in the ground lightning a strike leaves behind (about 2.4 m around it, for up to 10 s) is shocked once a second with the game's Lightning effect and takes Storm Hazard Damage. It stops when the strike fades or the storm ends. During an Ash Storm a player out in the open (not under a roof or indoors) burns every 5 seconds instead. Players in god mode or ghost mode are not affected. Host setting: applies to every player in the world and takes effect at once.
strings.cfg_effects__storm_hazard_damage_help: Damage per second to a player standing in a strike's ground lightning; armor and resistances apply. All lightning, except while Strike Starts Fires is on and it is not raining: then half lightning and half fire (5 becomes 2.5 + 2.5). An Ash Storm burn deals this as fire damage every 5 seconds. 0: status effects only. Host setting: applies to every player in the world and takes effect at once.
strings.cfg_notices__warning_message_help: A center message when a warning starts where you are. While a player window is open (inventory, map, menus, MeadWorks windows) the message goes to the message log only. When Cairn's weather display is on, Cairn shows it instead.
strings.cfg_notices__hud_badge_help: A small badge with the coming event and its countdown. Hidden while Cairn shows the warning on its weather HUD and while a player window is open; movable in the HUD layout editor.
strings.cfg_notices__warning_sound_help: A game sound when a warning starts where you are.
strings.cfg_cheats__weather_commands_help: Allows the tempest console verbs that summon or stop a weather event for everyone (status is always available).
strings.cfg_cheats__personal_weather_override_he: Allows 'tempest override <environment> [freeze]': your own sky only, never the shared event; cleared when an event starts where you are.

strings.cfg_weather_filter_other__disabled_envir: Other environment names (for example from other mods) the game should never choose, separated by commas. Names containing 'clear' are ignored.
strings.cfg_seasonal_weather__spring_weights_hel: Tempest host setting: weather weights for this Solstice season. Comma-separated environment names and weights from 0 to 4, for example Rain=0.5,ThunderStorm=0. Empty: unchanged. A base name also covers its seasonal variants; an exact variant overrides it. Zero removes ordinary weather; clear skies and Tempest events are always kept. Applies live to all players while Solstice effects are active. Solstice owns the season; Tempest owns weather selection.
